In this work, the as-cast Al1.1CoCrFeNi2.1 (at%) high-entropy alloy was prepared in a vacuum magnetic levitation induction furnace. The raw materials of high purity Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni (>99.9 at% pure) were remelted at least 5 times in the Ar atmosphere to guarantee homogeneity.

Tensile tests were conducted at−100◦C (−100-alloy), 23± 2◦C (room temperature, RT-alloy), and elevated temperatures of 650◦C (650-alloy), 750◦C (750-alloy), and 850◦C (850-alloy) in air with a strain rate of 10−3 s−1. Dog-bone ﬂat samples with the size of 49 mm× 12 mm were machined from the as-cast samples.
